query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('org',(SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM organizations o WHERE id=$1),'state',(SELECT jsonb_agg(s ORDER BY user_id) FROM person_permission_states s WHERE org_id=$1),'people',(SELECT jsonb_agg(p ORDER BY id) FROM person_management_assignments p WHERE org_id=$1),'projects',(SELECT jsonb_agg(p ORDER BY id) FROM project_management_assignments p WHERE org_id=$1),'receipts',(SELECT count(*) FROM permission_change_receipts WHERE org_id=$1))
